question: Does the VPN Gate relay sweep of 35 distinct exit ASNs reproduce, and does LG Powercomm appear among them?
why: A registry lookup of 75 relay addresses (one per distinct /16) found KORNET-KR, BBTEC, KDDI-NET, OCN and SO-NET blocks and LG-HELLOVISION-KR, but no object named for LG Powercomm; the original sweep cannot be re-read, so the 35 ASN count and its leading carriers stay a sweep figure.
